natural_language_statement:
Let $T:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ be the shortcut Collatz map: $T(n)=n/2$ for even $n$ and $T(n)=(3n+1)/2$ for odd $n$. Write $T^k$ for its $k$-fold iterate, with $T^0(n)=n$.

For every $z\in\mathbb N$,

$$
T^3(8z+3)=9z+4.
$$

This is the elementary block underlying the guarded burst construction.
